EXPERIMENTAL FACILITY

Large Rotating Tank

大型旋转水槽

← All facilities

The large rotating tank is approximately 1.1 m in diameter and 0.2 m high. It is equipped with power, imaging, and sheet-lighting systems for laboratory simulations of large-scale atmospheric and oceanic motions.
